svg.text: s7_doutpd: pull-downs that hold the unused harness dig_out[11:0] of slot 7 low
M0..M11: sg13_hv_nmos 0.5u / 0.45u, drain on d<k> (harness dig_out<k>), gate on vdd_1v2, source on vss_1v2,
bulk on vss_3v3. While the slot vdd_1v2 is up each line is pulled to vss_1v2; with vdd_1v2 off the lines float.
Back-annotated from the slot layout. Source: netlist/source/slot_7.spice (subckt s7_doutpd).
